metadata.description: Five forge-independent owner requirements; no production authorization.

controls.title: Within owner delegation
controls.objective: The change MUST stay within owner-approved paths and change types. Change size is not an eligibility signal.

assessment-requirements.text: The change MUST stay within owner-approved paths and change types. Change size is not an eligibility signal.

controls.title: No unresolved review concerns
controls.objective: Review MUST be complete and approved, with acceptable risk and no unresolved findings.

assessment-requirements.text: Review MUST be complete and approved, with acceptable risk and no unresolved findings.

controls.title: Required checks pass
controls.objective: Every configured required check MUST succeed for the current candidate revision.

assessment-requirements.text: Every configured required check MUST succeed for the current candidate revision.

controls.title: Evidence belongs to this revision
controls.objective: Evidence MUST refer to the configured repository, candidate, target and policy, and the trusted publication context. Live authenticity requires a forge adapter.

assessment-requirements.text: Evidence MUST refer to the configured repository, candidate, target and policy, and the trusted publication context. Live authenticity requires a forge adapter.

controls.title: Protected merge requirements hold
controls.objective: The target MUST remain protected, the policy gate required, blocking discussions resolved and bypass disabled.

assessment-requirements.text: The target MUST remain protected, the policy gate required, blocking discussions resolved and bypass disabled.
